items.title: Open Source pg_vectorsearch Brings More Scalable Vector Search to PostgreSQL
items.summaryShort: Open Source pg_vectorsearch Brings More Scalable Vector Search to PostgreSQL. Tiger Data has released pg_vectorsearch, an open source PostgreSQL extension for vector similarity search, currently in alpha.

items.title: Varlock Releases Bumpy: A File-Based Versioning Alternative to Changesets
items.summaryShort: Varlock Releases Bumpy: A File-Based Versioning Alternative to Changesets. Bumpy is an MIT-licensed, TypeScript tool for version management and changelogs in monorepos.

items.title: Yelp Combines Native and Server-Driven UI for Its AI Assistant
items.summaryShort: Yelp Combines Native and Server-Driven UI for Its AI Assistant. Yelp combines native mobile controls with server-driven conversation rendering in its AI Assistant using the CHAOS framework.

items.title: Binance CFO is leaving to ‘pursue a new venture' after $6.3 billion hack
items.summaryShort: Binance CFO is leaving to ‘pursue a new venture' after $6.3 billion hack. The announcement comes barely more than a week after hackers stole $6.3 billion worth of cryptocurrency from Binance users.

items.title: Amazon's new basic Kindle proves you don't need all the bells and whistles
items.summaryShort: Amazon's new basic Kindle proves you don't need all the bells and whistles. Amazon's redesigned basic Kindle costs more than before, but its lighter build and improved display make a compelling case for skipping the pricier models.

items.title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era
items.summaryShort: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era. Sequoia pioneered the scouts model and many VC firms followed suit, but a consensus now seems to be forming that the model has reached limits in its current form.
